from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper and its references to other papers in the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this paper")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers explicitly cited in this paper's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
